title: Use an uploaded photorealistic character sheet as the exact identity reference…
content:
Use an uploaded photorealistic character sheet as the exact identity reference and explicitly instruct Seedance to preserve facial structure, hairstyle, eye color, body proportions, costume, weapons/accessories, materials, and overall appearance consistently in every frame.

Use an uploaded photorealistic environment sheet as the exact location reference and explicitly instruct Seedance to preserve architecture, street layout, material details, lantern placement, rooftops, lighting style, atmospheric conditions, and color palette without redesigning the scene.

Specify negative constraints for action realism (e.g., “no ladders of any kind”) to force the model to use only natural architectural handholds during the climb.

Control cinematography by writing a shot-by-shot camera plan (establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up) and require smooth crane/tracking motion with no abrupt cuts, handheld shake, or rapid zooms.

Prioritize identity consistency by explicitly stating it as the highest priority and repeating “do not redesign, simplify, or alter” for both character and environment.

Lock the intended look by specifying lighting and rendering targets (cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K) and a fixed duration (15 seconds).

es.content:
Usa una hoja de personaje fotorrealista subida como referencia exacta de identidad e indica explícitamente a Seedance que preserve de forma consistente en cada fotograma la estructura facial, el peinado, el color de ojos, las proporciones corporales, el vestuario, las armas/accesorios, los materiales y el aspecto general.

Usa una hoja de entorno fotorrealista subida como referencia exacta de ubicación e indica explícitamente a Seedance que preserve la arquitectura, la distribución de las calles, los detalles de los materiales, la colocación de los faroles, las azoteas, el estilo de iluminación, las condiciones atmosféricas y la paleta de color sin rediseñar la escena.

Especifica restricciones negativas para el realismo de la acción (por ejemplo, “no ladders of any kind”) para obligar al modelo a usar solo apoyos arquitectónicos naturales durante la escalada.

Controla la cinematografía escribiendo un plan de cámara plano por plano (establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up) y exige un movimiento suave de crane/tracking, sin cortes bruscos, temblor de handheld ni zooms rápidos.

Prioriza la consistencia de identidad indicando explícitamente que es la máxima prioridad y repitiendo “do not redesign, simplify, or alter” tanto para el personaje como para el entorno.

Bloquea el aspecto deseado especificando los objetivos de iluminación y renderizado (cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K) y una duración fija (15 seconds).

fr.content:
Utilisez une feuille de personnage photoréaliste importée comme référence d’identité exacte et demandez explicitement à Seedance de préserver de manière cohérente, dans chaque image, la structure du visage, la coiffure, la couleur des yeux, les proportions du corps, le costume, les armes/accessoires, les matériaux et l’apparence générale.

Utilisez une feuille d’environnement photoréaliste importée comme référence exacte du lieu et demandez explicitement à Seedance de préserver l’architecture, le tracé des rues, les détails des matériaux, l’emplacement des lanternes, les toits, le style d’éclairage, les conditions atmosphériques et la palette de couleurs sans redessiner la scène.

Spécifiez des contraintes négatives pour le réalisme de l’action (par exemple, « no ladders of any kind ») afin de forcer le modèle à n’utiliser que des prises architecturales naturelles pendant l’ascension.

Contrôlez la cinématographie en rédigeant un plan caméra plan par plan (establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up) et exigez un mouvement fluide de crane/tracking, sans coupes abruptes, sans tremblements handheld ni zooms rapides.

Priorisez la cohérence d’identité en l’énonçant explicitement comme la priorité absolue et en répétant « do not redesign, simplify, or alter » pour le personnage comme pour l’environnement.

Verrouillez le rendu souhaité en spécifiant les objectifs d’éclairage et de rendu (cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K) ainsi qu’une durée fixe (15 seconds).

ja.content:
アップロードしたフォトリアルなキャラクターシートを、正確なアイデンティティ参照として使用し、Seedance に対して、顔の骨格、髪型、瞳の色、体のプロポーション、衣装、武器／アクセサリー、素材感、そして全体の外見を各フレームで一貫して維持するよう明示的に指示します。

アップロードしたフォトリアルな環境シートを、正確なロケーション参照として使用し、Seedance に対して、建築、街路のレイアウト、素材のディテール、提灯の配置、屋根、ライティングスタイル、気象・大気条件、カラーパレットを、シーンを再設計することなく維持するよう明示的に指示します。

アクションのリアリズムのためにネガティブ制約を指定し（例：「no ladders of any kind」）、登攀中は自然な建築上の手掛かりのみを使うようモデルを強制します。

ショットごとのカメラプラン（establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up）を記述して撮影設計をコントロールし、急なカット、手持ちの揺れ、急速なズームなしで、滑らかな crane/tracking motion を要求します。

アイデンティティの一貫性を最優先事項として明示し、キャラクターと環境の両方について “do not redesign, simplify, or alter” を繰り返して指定します。

照明とレンダリングの目標（cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K）および固定尺（15 seconds）を指定して、意図したルックを固定します。

ko.content:
업로드한 포토리얼리스틱 캐릭터 시트를 정확한 아이덴티티 레퍼런스로 사용하고, Seedance가 매 프레임마다 얼굴 구조, 헤어스타일, 눈 색, 신체 비율, 의상, 무기/액세서리, 재질, 전체적인 외형을 일관되게 유지하도록 명시적으로 지시하세요.

업로드한 포토리얼리스틱 환경 시트를 정확한 장소 레퍼런스로 사용하고, Seedance가 장면을 재설계하지 않도록 건축 양식, 거리 배치, 재질 디테일, 등불 배치, 지붕선, 조명 스타일, 대기 조건, 색상 팔레트를 그대로 유지하도록 명시적으로 지시하세요.

액션의 사실감을 위해 부정 제약을 지정하세요(예: “no ladders of any kind”) — 이를 통해 모델이 등반 시 자연스러운 건축물의 손잡이만 사용하도록 강제합니다.

샷별 카메라 플랜을 작성해 촬영 구성을 제어하세요(establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up) 그리고 급작스러운 컷, 핸드헬드 흔들림, 빠른 줌 없이 부드러운 crane/tracking 모션을 요구하세요.

아이덴티티 일관성을 최우선으로 두고, 캐릭터와 환경 모두에 대해 “do not redesign, simplify, or alter”를 반복해서 명시하세요.

조명과 렌더링 목표를 지정해 원하는 룩을 고정하세요(cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K) 그리고 고정된 길이(15 seconds)를 설정하세요.

pt.content:
Use uma character sheet fotorealista enviada como referência exata de identidade e instrua explicitamente o Seedance a preservar de forma consistente, em cada frame, a estrutura facial, o penteado, a cor dos olhos, as proporções corporais, o figurino, as armas/acessórios, os materiais e a aparência geral.

Use uma environment sheet fotorealista enviada como referência exata de localização e instrua explicitamente o Seedance a preservar a arquitetura, o traçado das ruas, os detalhes dos materiais, a posição dos lampiões, os telhados, o estilo de iluminação, as condições atmosféricas e a paleta de cores, sem redesenhar a cena.

Especifique restrições negativas para realismo da ação (por exemplo, “no ladders of any kind”) para forçar o modelo a usar apenas apoios arquitetônicos naturais durante a escalada.

Controle a cinematografia escrevendo um plano de câmera shot by shot (establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up) e exija movimento suave de crane/tracking, sem cortes abruptos, tremor de handheld ou zooms rápidos.

Priorize a consistência de identidade declarando explicitamente que ela é a prioridade máxima e repetindo “do not redesign, simplify, or alter” tanto para o personagem quanto para o ambiente.

Trave o visual pretendido especificando os alvos de iluminação e rendering (cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K) e uma duração fixa (15 seconds).

zh.content:
使用上传的写实角色设定图作为精确的身份参考，并明确指示 Seedance 在每一帧中一致地保留面部结构、发型、眼睛颜色、身体比例、服装、武器/配饰、材质以及整体外观。

使用上传的写实环境设定图作为精确的场景参考，并明确指示 Seedance 保留建筑结构、街道布局、材质细节、灯笼位置、屋顶、光照风格、大气条件和色彩方案，且不要对场景进行重新设计。

为动作真实性设置负向约束（例如“no ladders of any kind”），以强制模型在攀爬过程中只使用自然的建筑攀附点。

通过编写逐镜头的 camera plan 来控制 cinematography（establishing shot → vertical tracking climb → arc reveal at roofline → side-tracking on rooftop → slow push-in to medium close-up），并要求平滑的 crane/tracking 运动，不要有突然切镜、手持抖动或快速变焦。

通过明确声明 identity consistency 为最高优先级，并对角色和环境都重复“do not redesign, simplify, or alter”，来优先保证身份一致性。

通过指定 lighting 和 rendering 目标（cool moonlight + warm lantern rim highlights, wet-surface reflections, volumetric mist/fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic color grading, ultra-photorealistic/PBR, 8K）以及固定时长（15 seconds），锁定预期效果。
